# Worth the Watch?

> AI-powered movie and TV show verdicts based on critic reviews, Reddit discussions, and audience scores. No spoilers, just the truth.

## What this site does

Worth the Watch aggregates opinions from professional critics, Reddit communities, and real viewers to generate instant verdicts on whether a movie or TV show is worth your time. Each title receives a clear verdict: WORTH IT, NOT WORTH IT, or MIXED BAG — along with specific praise points, criticism points, and aggregated scores from IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, and Metacritic.

## How to find reviews

Every reviewed title has a dedicated page at:

    https://worth-the-watch.vercel.app/movie/{tmdb_id}

For TV shows, append `?type=tv`:

    https://worth-the-watch.vercel.app/movie/{tmdb_id}?type=tv

The TMDB ID is from The Movie Database (themoviedb.org).

## Browse categories

- Worth It picks: https://worth-the-watch.vercel.app/browse/worth-it
- Skip These: https://worth-the-watch.vercel.app/browse/skip-these
- Mixed Bag: https://worth-the-watch.vercel.app/browse/mixed-bag
- Hidden Gems: https://worth-the-watch.vercel.app/browse/hidden-gems
- Latest reviews: https://worth-the-watch.vercel.app/browse/latest
- Trending: https://worth-the-watch.vercel.app/browse/trending
- TV Shows: https://worth-the-watch.vercel.app/browse/tv-shows
- Advanced filtering: https://worth-the-watch.vercel.app/discover

## Available data per review

- Verdict: WORTH IT, NOT WORTH IT, or MIXED BAG
- Review summary: 150-250 words, conversational, no spoilers
- Hook: one-sentence summary of the verdict
- Praise points: 2-3 specific things the title does well
- Criticism points: 2-3 specific weaknesses
- Tags: mood/style descriptors (e.g., Cerebral, Feel-Good, Slow-Burn, Action-Packed)
- Scores: IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic (when available)
- Confidence level: HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW based on source availability
- Critic vs audience sentiment comparison
- Streaming availability (US)

## About

Worth the Watch is an independent project. Reviews are synthesized from multiple public sources using AI, not written by a single critic. The goal is to answer one question clearly: "Is this worth my time?"
